Result: fold0 screen PQ 0.3692 vs 0.3788 (-0.0096), RQ 0.558 vs 0.572, FP/FN both worse. Extra channels hurt at 10ep; zscore may add noise / dilute the pretrained first layer. Keep flat-only.

postprocess-only on exp000 probs (configs/pp_merge12.yaml, source_exp exp000): fragment bridging merge_radius=12 (components whose 12px dilations touch become one instance, pixels unchanged). Hypothesis from error analysis (138 fragmented FN, 76 recoverable) and nicolasasmann V5 (+0.8pp near-miss merge). Predicted +0.006, >=4/5 folds. Result: see delta; FP down ~15%, TP -2%.

calibration run 1/2 for sigma_seed (configs/calib_seed43.yaml: base.yaml with seed 43, same training as exp000 + exp002 postprocess merge12). Result: CV 0.3999 vs exp002 0.3994 (+0.0004); folds 0.389/0.405/0.390/0.406/0.409 vs 0.400/0.407/0.386/0.397/0.408 -> per-fold seed spread ~0.01 but the 5-fold mean moves <0.001. test 7.19 preds/img (exp002 7.68).

postprocess-only on exp000 probs (configs/pp_score086.yaml): exp002 merge12 + score_min 0.86. Predicted +0.0038, 5/5 folds. OOF result: CV 0.4036 (+0.0041), 5/5 folds, replicated on the seed-43 OOF of exp003 (+0.0038, 5/5) -> the OOF gain is real. DISCARD anyway: the gate does not transfer to the test pipeline. Test maps are 5-fold averages and less saturated (35% mid-range pixels vs 20% in OOF), so component scores have a heavier low tail (5% quantile 0.74 vs 0.87): score_min 0.86 drops 16% of test instances vs 3.4% of OOF (7.68 -> 6.08 preds/img). CV cannot validate that. Lesson: any score-based gate must be tuned on OOF maps averaged over seeds (exp000+exp003+exp005), see research/logs/2026-09-30_exp004_score_min.md.

calibration run 2/2 for sigma_seed (configs/calib_seed44.yaml: base.yaml with seed 44). Result: CV 0.3961 vs exp002 0.3994 (-0.0034); folds 0.389/0.407/0.388/0.395/0.403. Three seeds (42/43/44): CV 0.3994 / 0.3999 / 0.3961 -> sigma_seed 0.0021, 2*sigma 0.0041 < min_delta 0.005 -> theta_keep = 0.005.

seed ensemble without retraining (configs/ens_seed3.yaml, tools/average_probs.py): OOF/test probability maps of exp000/exp003/exp005 (seeds 42/43/44) averaged, then merge_radius 12. Predicted +0.003..+0.005, >=4/5 folds. Result: CV 0.4048 (+0.0053 vs exp002), folds 4/5 (fold0 -0.002), pooled OOF 0.4044; FP -107, TP +33. test 7.19 preds/img (OOF 7.10). Averaged maps are softer (mid-range pixels 20% -> ~35%), which also makes score gates transferable (see exp007).

exp006 (3-seed averaged maps, merge 12) + score_min 0.82 (configs/ens_seed3_score082.yaml). 3-seed OOF sweep: plateau 0.80-0.86 (0.4101-0.4115); 0.82 chosen on the low side because test (15-model average) has a heavier low-score tail than the 3-model OOF. Predicted CV 0.4101, 5/5 folds. Result: CV 0.4105 (+0.0058 vs exp006, +0.0111 vs exp002), 5/5 folds, FP -431, TP -100. Dropped 6.7% of OOF instances and 11.4% of test instances (6.37 preds/img) - inside the plateau as intended.

reference screen for the current post-processing (base.yaml: flat 1ch, soft_mean target, merge 12, score_min 0.82; fold0 10ep, seed 42). PQ 0.3808 (exp000's screen with the old post-processing was 0.3788). Comparison point for target/loss screens; single-model maps are saturated so score_min 0.82 removes ~1% here.

target.solo_weight 0.0 (configs/exp_target_solo0.yaml): drop 'only me' filaments (no IoU>0.5 match in another record of the image) from the soft target. Predicted +0.004..+0.010 vs exp008 0.3808. Result: fold0 screen 0.3796 (-0.0012): FP 849->751 but TP 1125->1078 and FN 801->848 -> net zero. Why: with the soft-mean target a solo filament in a 3-record image already has value 1/3 (< threshold 0.5), so the filter only changes 2-record images (0.5 -> 0), and by the PQ rule (u > 0.5*PQ*n = 0.41 for n=2) those are worth predicting when matched at IoU ~0.6. The consensus gain reported by nicolasasmann must come from the per-epoch annotator sampling or a hard-union base target, not from the filter itself. Flag kept (default off).

recall-oriented Tversky region loss (configs/exp_tversky.yaml: alpha 0.3 / beta 0.7 vs Dice 0.5/0.5; screen at score_min 0). Predicted +0.002..+0.008 with FN down / FP up. Result: fold0 0.3544 (-0.026): FP 849->1004, FN 801->818 (not down), SQ 0.660->0.646, 8.6 preds/img. The FN-weighted loss inflates masks (blobbier, lower IoU) without recovering the missed thin/faint filaments: those are absent from the probability map, not under-segmented. Clear discard; alpha/beta stay at 0.5 (default).

photometric augmentation gain U(0.9,1.1) + Gaussian noise std 0.015 on the flat channel (configs/exp_photo_aug.yaml, src/data._augment). Predicted +0.002..0.006; result fold0 0.3649 = -0.0224 vs exp011 screen 0.3873. Diagnosis: the flat channel is normalised so the quiet disk is always 1.0 (x = 0 after norm); a gain of 1.1 shifts the whole image by 0.83 std, destroying that invariant, so the net has to re-learn the absolute level every batch. Gain is the wrong augmentation for a flattened channel; noise alone is still untested (separate screen).

spine auxiliary head (configs/exp_spine.yaml: target.spine_width 5 px, second Unet output channel, train.spine_weight 0.5; src/data.spine_target, src/train.multi_head_loss).
